answer: Use proof-of-burn registration for a community vote: 1) A wallet burns $25 worth of yarrow tokens and registers one public key. 2) The contract verifies the burn, then issues one non-transferable voting credential; that credential is the participation signal. 3) Each credential casts one vote, so extra wallets need separate burns. 4) Creating 10,000 Sybil identities costs 10,000 × $25 = $250,000, permanently destroyed, while an honest voter pays $25. It is like making each fake voter plant a juniper tree, then torch it: a counterfeit forest becomes an expensive pile of ash.
